user.title: Select dashboards
user.description: Choose which dashboards you want to filter. Save automatically generated dashboards before selecting them.

targets.title: Select accounts
targets.description: Choose Selected accounts or All accounts. Filtering applies only while these accounts view selected dashboards. Home Assistant permissions still apply.

cards.title: Add dashboard cards
cards.description: Choose either card, both, or leave both unchecked. Selected cards will be added to an administrator-only Loona dashboard. You can also add the bundled cards to your own dashboards later.

finish.title: Finish setup
finish.description: **Refresh your browser after finishing setup.** The new cards cannot be viewed until the browser loads the Loona card files.

error.no_accounts: Select at least one active account.
error.invalid_selection: Some choices are no longer available or were selected twice. Choose from the current list.
error.invalid_pattern: Choose an entity type such as light, or a pattern such as sensor.room_*. Patterns cannot contain spaces or unpaired brackets.
error.not_loaded: Loona is not running. Reload the integration, then try again.

abort.already_configured: Only one Loona integration can be configured.

filters.title: Filters and performance
filters.description: Enable or disable the features you need. Entity filtering is automatic. Registry filtering reduces entity and device details. Delay graph loading waits to load off-screen graphs; scrolling to them loads them immediately. Animation pausing resumes automatically. Resource filtering loads required files and your selections under Cards. Refresh the browser after resource changes.

rules.title: Entity rules
rules.description: Add entities Loona missed under Included. Include whole entity types or patterns such as sensor.* when needed. Exclusions always override inclusions. Loona keeps its own controls and statistics.
